commitResults.messageTitle: Restore reliable macOS CI checks
commitResults.messageBody:
Use the Intel macOS runner after ARM64 capacity failures. Exclude only
display-dependent JavaFX tests on GitHub macOS, where the test JVM aborts
with SIGABRT. Retain all remaining tests and Checkstyle on macOS, and the
full GUI suite on Linux, Windows and local desktop runs.

The course FAQ permits selective GUI testing by environment. Document
this CI boundary without changing production code.

Refs #159
